title: "rungar config"
description: "Print a configuration file as the daemon would run it, in YAML"
---

Print the whole configuration in a file as the daemon would load it: every default filled in, Rungar's and each provider type's, and anchors and merge keys resolved. Inline secrets -- a GitHub token or App key, a provider's token -- are printed as REDACTED. Runner blocks are printed as written, the provider's and each scale set's for it. Like validate, it contacts nothing and needs no daemon, and it fails on a file the daemon would not start from.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar config [flags]
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar config migrate`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_config_migrate" >}}) | Rewrite a configuration file for this version of Rungar. |

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-f`, `--config string` | Configuration file. Default: `/etc/rungar/config.yaml`. |
